_note: CoreLifecycle topic queue — REPLACED 2026-08-11 (WO-10) for the format swap. The channel now produces THIRD-PERSON PAST-TENSE EXPLAINERS about REAL subjects (famous companies, business figures, financial scandals, economic crises), not fictional POV rank ladders. Showrunner pulls the next UNPRODUCED slug top-to-bottom; when exhausted, invent a new one in the same subject space. Each item's `format` selects the TITLE FORMULA (see _formats); `title_hint` is already inside the measured 36-64 char band; `environments` are PLAIN-ENGLISH SCENE ARCHETYPES, NOT template identifiers — never put one in a `template=` (see docs/BIBLE.md §8). Every topic needs docs/research/<slug>.md with dates, figures and quotes VERIFIED before writing; unverified detail is cut, not softened. `proof` states measured demand ONLY where it cites a number from docs/research/crayon/MEASUREMENTS.md; everything else is explicitly marked as rationale, not data.

_formats.eli5: <Subject> Explained Like You're 5 — the dominant formula (17 of the reference channel's 28 videos). Use for a mechanism, a scandal, or a crisis.
_formats.how: How <Person> Actually <Verb>ed <Thing> — use for a single named person's decisive act. Runs SHORT; count characters against the 36-64 band.
_formats.superlative: The <Superlative> <Noun> That <Surprise> — use when the paradox is stronger than the subject's name.

_learned: PERFORMANCE DATA CAVEAT 2026-08-11: ops/analytics.json (33 videos) measures the RETIRED second-person POV-ladder format and says nothing about which explainer subjects work. Recorded for history: under the old format the winning axis was BUILDER ASPIRATION (founder = 410 views, 41% of the channel) and every passive/elite-money ladder flopped (trillionaire = 0, real_estate_mogul = 16, billionaire_heir = 19, investment_banker = 24, hedge_fund_manager = 40). Do NOT carry that guidance into topic selection here — the explainer format has no view data of its own yet. The only measured signal available is the reference channel's own ranking in docs/research/crayon/MEASUREMENTS.md, where FRAUD and CRISIS outrank FOUNDER BIOGRAPHY: Wolf of Wall Street 4.18M > Great Depression 2.68M > 2008 Crisis 2.25M > Rockefeller 1.22M > Bezos 939K > Singapore 896K > Enron 872K. The queue is ordered fraud-and-collapse first to match that.
_environment_set: The narrow environment vocabulary the new template set is being built against (docs/research/crayon/TEMPLATE_STRATEGY.md). NOT template names: office / cubicle floor · boardroom · trading floor · bank or institutional exterior · street · domestic interior · courtroom or hearing · factory / industrial · newspaper & document montage · broadcast or news frame · crowd or queue · character close-up · chart & diagram · multi-panel split · full-screen text card
